description: Comment “Contact” and I’ll send you the full guide 👇 You can now find the name, position, and email of any employee at any business directly inside Claude. Here’s how to set it up in 30 seconds: 1. Go to Claude → Customize → Connectors → Browse Connectors 2. Search for Vibe Prospecting and connect it 3. This gives Claude access to a full database of 800M+ professional profiles and 150M+ business entities Now just say: “Find me [position] at [company] and give me their contact info using Vibe Prospecting.” Claude pulls that person’s exact name, position, and email for you. Here’s the bonus prompt to protect your own privacy: Say: “Now if any of my information is in these databases, how do I get myself removed?” Claude finds out where you’re listed and hands you the exact steps to opt out. No expensive lead gen tools. No thousands a month. Just Claude. #ai #claude #leadgeneration #vibeprospecting #aitools
